d: Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke avsar par jan suraj ke sansthapak aur vidhayak prashant kishor rajdhani patna ke kachchi talab chhath ghat pahunche. is dauran unhonne ghat par maujud chhathavratiyon, shraddhaluon aur sthaniy logon se mulakat ki tatha sabhi ko chhath mahaparv ki hardik shubhkamnaen din.
